environment.observation: Rendered UI/accessibility tree; local mock banner visible on data pages
environment.viewport: browser-managed viewport; this check does not certify a device-size matrix

checks.action: Inspect the legacy shell bottom navigation.
checks.expected: The five core destinations are available.
checks.actual: Trang chủ, Thị trường, Giao dịch, Ví, Tôi were present as navigation buttons.

checks.action: Click the Prediction Markets card, then its Quay lại button.
checks.expected: CTA opens its target and back returns to the originating market page.
checks.actual: The CTA opened /r/markets/predictions with 12 event cards; in-app back returned to /r/markets.

checks.action: Open the URL directly and reload the browser page.
checks.expected: The nested route remains addressable after a hard browser entry and reload.
checks.actual: Both before and after reload the URL remained /w/markets/predictions and 12 event cards rendered.

checks.expected: The application renders its not-found page rather than a blank screen.
checks.actual: Rendered “404 — Not Found”, explanatory text and Quay lại/Tải lại trang actions.

checks.action: Open a protected wallet URL while the preview persona reports guest/logged out.
checks.actual: The browser URL changed to /auth/login and the login form rendered. The original query/hash were not visible in the address bar after redirect; preservation of the return destination is asserted by PairDetailPage.test.tsx.

checks.action: Click Open Arena while the preview persona reports guest/logged out.
checks.expected: The protected destination redirects to login.
checks.actual: The browser URL changed to /auth/login and the login form rendered.

openGap.note: Only the web-shell declaration exists. The root, phone and legacy candidate paths do not resolve to a route; do not imply the existing web page covers those shells.

limitations: Preview data is mocked; no backend request or staging account was certified.
This is a representative browser route check, not acceptance of all 128 source pages or a responsive device matrix.
The protected redirect query/hash are not visible after redirect; return-state preservation is verified by the targeted React test, not inferred from the URL.
